column1: # Monetary regimes (hand-written). regime: own | union | peg.
#   union: area = name of the currency union; one central-bank agent sets the rate for all members.
#   peg:   anchor = ISO3 of the anchor currency's nation; the central bank follows its rate.
#   reserve: reserve-currency status 0..1 (lowers sovereign risk premia); US dollar = 1.
# Sources: ECB (euro area membership 2020); SAMA (riyal pegged to USD since 1986); IMF COFER
